two_things_a_seal_can_be_here.native_seal: A Rust Seal requires a formed native witness with its own formation and closure semantics. Nothing in this record has one: there is no native import, no derivation certificate and no checked witness behind it, so no native Seal is issued here and none is issuable from this material. The directory-separated Pascal-rooted growth obligation keeps its own fixed checkpoint at RecordedOpen with native_seal NotIssued.
two_things_a_seal_can_be_here.documentary_checkpoint: A documentary checkpoint pins a record by digest and discharges nothing. It is not a Rust Seal, and pinning an obligation is not discharging it. This file is the second kind, and it is named a checkpoint rather than a seal so that it cannot be read as the first.

what_it_does_not_do: Does not discharge the directory-separated Pascal-rooted growth obligation, which stays Open with native_seal NotIssued; it does not rewrite, reseal or reinterpret that fixed obligation or its fixed checkpoint.
Does not issue a Rust Seal, register a native witness, or promote a documentary entry to native admission.
Does not establish that Absurdity is empty, and does not establish that it is nonempty.
Does not authorize the recorded operation or any trial built on it. A trial still needs its own frozen six-part contract under Research 0129 section 3.
Does not turn any physical value named in the record into a repository claim, and does not resolve any provenance question outside this record.

Does not make the sealed content immune. Closure ends the registration, not the argument: a later note may supersede this record and a challenge may reopen it, appended rather than rewritten, and this checkpoint must not be cited as a reason to refuse that.
